import React, { useState } from "react";

type Props = { title: string; items?: string[] };

export function App({ title, items = [] }: Props) {
  const [count, setCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const id = <T,>(x: T) => x;
  const constrained = <T extends object>(x: T): T => x;
  const less = count < 10 && count > 0;
  return (
    <div className="app" data-count={count} {...rest}>
      <h1>{title} &amp; more &#x1F;</h1>
      <Foo.Bar enabled value='single &lt;' />
      <svg:path d="M0 0" />
      <>
        {items.map((item, i) => <li key={i}>{item}</li>)}
      </>
      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Count: {count}</button>
      {/* comment */}
    </div>
  );
}

const el = <span>{`template ${count}`}</span>;
let n: number = 1;
let s: string = "x";
